compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: patterns plus relations tables reused as-is with no migration; gallery/flows/search/boards untouched; inventory 24->26 with the three count assertions updated; validator URI set extended with pattern; skill step added? reliability.instructions: Any reliability risk: examined-cap truncation reported instead of silent prefixes; deterministic repeatability; invalid slugs/limits/cursors fail closed; rate limits and identity unchanged; no new migration to rehearse?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the P10-C1 reads grain: pattern write/mutation paths, taxonomy UI, rrweb capture, or unrelated refactors? Are writes correctly absent (taxonomy is curated through the existing graph writes, not new verbs)?

security.instructions: Does the grain weaken any control: central-gate visibility per linked artifact; withheld titles never in JSON on either transport; malformed slugs fail closed; no new auth surface; no secrets; budgets enforced?
